coverage.headline: Goliath Ventures CEO Pleads Guilty To Crypto Ponzi Scheme
coverage.summary: Goliath Ventures CEO Christopher Alexander Delgado pleaded guilty to wire fraud and money laundering charges connected to an alleged $400 million crypto Ponzi scheme. His sentencing hearing is scheduled for October 8, while the related bankruptcy cases remain pending before Judge Robert A. Mark.

coverage.headline: Goliath Ventures CEO pleads guilty in $400 million crypto Ponzi case
coverage.summary: Christopher Alexander Delgado pleaded guilty to conspiracy to commit wire fraud, wire fraud, and money laundering, admitting to causing at least $250 million in losses and agreeing to forfeit luxury assets. The bankruptcy cases remain pending before Judge Robert A. Mark, with Delgado's sentencing set for October 8.
